research_metadata.project_context: Tauri v2 Desktop App — ASCII Art Engine (macOS, Windows, Android). React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v3. User demands monochrome minimalism, zero AI-slop, working video/image processing, professional graph/stickers aesthetic.

recommended_color_system.rationale: User explicitly demands 'minimalism black and white' with 'professional graph/stickers'. Pure monochrome #000000/#ffffff with single blue accent only for interactive elements. Zero colorful gradients. Deep graphite surfaces (#0a0a0c, #141416) for subtle depth without color.

recommended_typography.rationale: Already installed in project. Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono for ASCII output and telemetry readouts. Monospace is critical for ASCII grid alignment.

recommended_animation_approach.pattern: Single orchestrated entrance reveal + processing spinner
recommended_animation_approach.rationale: User wants 'load animation when loading in the app interface'. CSS keyframes are zero-dependency, performant in Tauri webview, and match the minimalist ethos. No framer-motion needed.

anti_patterns_to_avoid: AI-slop gradient buttons (purple-to-blue, neon glow effects)
Colorful badges/tags (use monochrome chips with border only)
Rainbow status indicators (use desaturated single-color dots)
Excessive drop shadows (use 1px borders for depth)
Generic bento grid layouts with emoji icons
Framer-motion for simple loading states (CSS keyframes suffice)

icons.note: Already installed. Keep monochrome — use stroke icons only, no filled colored variants.

ui_primitives.note: No shadcn needed — this is a terminal/engine app, not a SaaS dashboard. Keep components minimal and native.

state.note: Already in use. No additional state library needed for this app's scope.

recommended_references.name: Linear App (Linear.app)
recommended_references.why: Gold standard for dark monochrome developer tools. Minimal borders, monospace telemetry, chip-based status indicators.

recommended_references.name: Raycast
recommended_references.why: Pure black background, white text, monospace output panels. Professional sticker/chip aesthetic.

recommended_references.name: 1Password CLI
recommended_references.why: Monochrome terminal-style documentation with professional graph/chip elements.

component_composition_sources.pattern: Native React components with Tailwind utilities
component_composition_sources.note: This is a specialized ASCII art engine, not a generic web app. Components are domain-specific (AsciiCanvas, ControlPanel, MediaPicker). Refactor existing components rather than replacing with generic UI kit components.

react_ts_decisions.component_pattern: Functional components with React.FC<Props> typing (existing pattern)
react_ts_decisions.state_pattern: useState + useCallback for performance-critical paths, useRef for DOM refs
react_ts_decisions.typescript_strictness: STRICT — existing contracts.ts provides Zod-validated types
key_idioms_to_use: useState with functional updates for nested state

community_verdict.sentiment_summary: Dark monochrome UIs are trending for developer tools in 2026. Community consensus: drop colorful accents, use pure B&W with subtle surface elevation for depth. Terminal/engine apps benefit from monospace typography throughout.
key_warnings: requestAnimationFrame alone is insufficient for video frame capture — it doesn't sync with video decode. Use requestVideoFrameCallback.
Canvas drawImage(video) only works when video.readyState >= 2 (HAVE_CURRENT_DATA). Must wait for loadeddata event.
Tauri v2 CSP is stricter than v1 — ensure blob: and mediastream: are in media-src for video playback.
Framer-motion adds 40KB+ gzipped — unnecessary for simple CSS transitions in a terminal-style app.
key_endorsements: CSS @keyframes for loading animations — zero dependency, GPU-accelerated, works in all webviews
requestVideoFrameCallback for frame-accurate video processing — standard in Chromium-based webviews (Tauri uses WebView2 on Windows, WKWebView on macOS)
Pure monochrome token system with CSS custom properties for consistent theming
lucide-react for monochrome stroke icons — already installed, fits the aesthetic perfectly

pattern_evidence: requestVideoFrameCallback + cancelVideoFrameCallback is the standard pattern for frame-accurate video processing in 2026
getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true }) is used by all production repos for pixel data extraction
CSS @keyframes loading animations dominate over framer-motion for simple spinners/loaders
Monochrome dark themes (#000000/#0a0a0c/#141416) are the standard for terminal/developer tool apps
